In [2]:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
In [3]:
years = [2022,2023,2024,2025,2026]
sales = [123,456,789,147,258]
profit = [100,200,10,600,10]
discount = [10,30,50,40,20]
In [4]:
plt.plot(years,sales, color = 'red',linestyle='--', marker= '^' , label='Sales') # line chart

plt.plot(years,profit, color = 'purple',linestyle=':', marker= 'o', label='Profit' )  # line chart

plt.fill_between(years,discount, color = 'green',linestyle='-.', label='Discount')  # area chart

for y,s in zip(years,sales):
    plt.text(y,s,s)

plt.title('Year wise sales', color = 'brown',fontsize=30, fontweight=10) #, verticalalignment=' , horizontalalignment=')

plt.legend()

plt.gca().set_facecolor('pink') # background

plt.xlabel('Years')

plt.ylabel('Score')


plt.show()
In [5]:
categories = ['T-shirt','drop shoulder', 'slim', 'straigth fit', 'sports', 'gym fit' ]
profit = [5000,12000,15000,3200,8500,6400]
In [6]:
plt.bar(x=categories, height=profit,
        color=['lightgreen', 'red', 'lightyellow','lightblue', 'grey', 'green'])
for c,p in zip(categories,profit):
    plt.text(c,p,p, verticalalignment='top', horizontalalignment='center')

plt.title('Year wise sales', color = 'brown',fontsize=30, fontweight=10) #, verticalalignment=' , horizontalalignment=')

plt.gca().set_facecolor('pink') # background

plt.xlabel('Years')

plt.ylabel('Score')


plt.show()
